task.claim.*.description: Claim on one task: the key is task.claim.<task-id>, and the value is the seat (agent or human) working on it.

release.freeze.description: A freeze window while releases are frozen; unset while releases are open. Set by override records.

deploy.hold.description: true while deploys are held; the reason rides in the record's reason field.

oncall.primary.description: FIRST declaration of the pager seat.
SECOND declaration of the pager seat — a duplicate.
